description: Engineering workflows for planning, implementation, review, and verification.

defaultPrompt: Use $pstack-codex:poteto-mode to plan and verify this change.
interface.longDescription: An independent MIT-licensed adaptation of Lauren Tan's pstack. Includes 55 skills, 24 engineering principles, and 23 playbooks for planning, architecture, implementation, code review, testing, technical writing, and verification. Workflows use the tools and permissions available in the current execution environment. Optional helpers have explicit dependency setup. Requires local execution. Supported environments and limitations are documented in the repository.

publication.release_notes: Prepares port 0.2.0 from upstream pstack 0.15.27. Adds the formal-verification workflow and updated engineering guidance while preserving Codex and Dots adapters, explicit invocation policies, external preferences, and MIT attribution. This development version is unpublished.

name: pstack-codex
